messages:
maria: Quick question about feature flag inheritance. I thought precedence is org > project > route > model (closest wins). But ran into a case where a model-level null was ignored and project-level value applied. Is null treated as 'no-override' or explicit 'inherit'? cc @ajay

ajay: By design we treat absence of a key as inherit, null is ambiguous. We recently added null -> 'explicit unset' in the parser but maybe not propagated to runtime yet.

leo: Example plz? show the JSON you saw.

maria: pasted
```json
{
  "org_flags": { "new_routing": false },
  "projects": { "p1": { "flags": { "new_routing": true }, "routes": { "/chat": { "flags": { "new_routing": null }, "models": { "gpt-lite": {} } } } }
}
```

maria: Model gpt-lite ended up with new_routing = true (project-level), expected to be unset and fall back to org(false) or be treated as explicit null -> disabled.

ajay: That is a bug — route null wasn't being interpreted. Runtime only looked for defined boolean. Will push fix to treat null as explicit override to 'unset/disabled' if route flags explicitly have null.

sara: What's the rollback plan? We have a canary using route overrides for a group of beta tenants.

ajay: Hotfix: add check in flag resolution: if value === null -> mark as 'explicitly unset' and stop searching lower levels; for older runtimes we fallback to treating null as inherit. We'll ship to canary only first 20% region.

maria: For docs, can we define semantics: explicit true/false wins; null means explicit 'unset' (do not inherit); absent key means inherit from parent. Otherwise people will be surprised.

leo: Also clarify precedence with rollout audiences: if route-level rollout exists but model-level has a conflicting rollout, which applies? my understanding: more specific (model) overrides.

ajay: Correct — override order: model > route > project > org for any flag/value including rollouts. But there are guardrails: you can't widen audiences by lower-level override (e.g., model can't enable for everyone if org disabled) — that's policy enforced at resolution time.

sara: Can we add an automated lint in infra that flags widening overrides? e.g., if parent has disabled=true and child enables=true -> block unless admin flag.

ajay: Yep I'll add a pre-deploy lint and a console warning. Will also add tests and update docs.

maria: OK thanks. @ajay ping me when you have the PR and I'll review.

feature-bot: Deploy scheduled: flag-resolver-null-handling -> canary (20%) at 2026-04-02T18:00Z :rocket:

maria: added note to the rollout checklist.
